attempts.summary: Configured node1 as an internal DNS resolver (dnsmasq) authoritative for inventory-api.internal -> node2's IP (10.100.162.11), forwarding all other queries upstream to 10.100.162.1. Configured node2 (systemd-networkd/systemd-resolved) to use node1 (10.100.162.10) as its sole DNS server, disabling DHCP-provided DNS. Verified resolution end-to-end via stub resolver, getent, resolvectl, and direct dig. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes, confirming boot_id changes and full post-restart recovery of DNS service and resolution behavior.
